## Summary

Closes #<issue>

## Type of change

- [ ] `feat`: new feature
- [ ] `fix`: bug fix
- [ ] `evol`: evolution or refactor of existing code
- [ ] `docs`: documentation only
- [ ] `chore` / `test` / `ci`

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (lint, tests, build)
- [ ] Tests added or updated, with external APIs mocked
- [ ] Documentation updated where relevant
- [ ] Reviewed and approved by another team member
